description: Source code for the STM32F10x Window Watchdog (WWDG) firmware functions, including initialization, configuration, and control functions for the watchdog peripheral.

methods.name: WWDG_DeInit
methods.description: Deinitializes the WWDG peripheral registers to their default reset values.

methods.name: WWDG_SetWindowValue
methods.description: Sets the WWDG window value for comparison.

methods.name: WWDG_EnableIT
methods.description: Enables the WWDG Early Wakeup interrupt.

methods.name: WWDG_Enable
methods.description: Enables WWDG and loads the counter value.

methods.name: WWDG_GetFlagStatus
methods.description: Checks if the Early Wakeup interrupt flag is set.

methods.name: WWDG_ClearFlag
methods.description: Clears the Early Wakeup interrupt flag.
